title: National Coaching Camp for BWF World Junior Championships 2026 Underway
indian_angle: This camp is crucial for preparing India's top junior talent for the upcoming BWF World Junior Championships.
summary: A national coaching camp is underway at NCE, Guwahati, to prepare Indian shuttlers for the BWF World Junior Championships 2026.

title: BAI Level-1 (Advanced) Coaches Course Announced for September
indian_angle: This course aims to enhance the skills of Indian badminton coaches, directly impacting player development across the country.
summary: Badminton Association of India (BAI) has announced a Level-1 (Advanced) Coaches Course to be held in Guwahati and Raipur from September 14-23, 2026.

summary: The Indian team is undergoing a coaching camp at the National Center of Excellence, Guwahati, in preparation for the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships 2026.

title: New 3x15 Scoring System Implemented for Domestic Junior Tournaments
indian_angle: This rule change will significantly impact how junior domestic ranking tournaments and national championships are played in India, affecting player strategy and development.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has implemented a new 3x15 scoring system for domestic ranking tournaments and national championships in the U-13, U-15, and U-17 age groups.
